desc:
🏀 ILLEGAL BASKETBALL 🏀

3v3 street ball with NO REFS. Punch, steal, swat and blast your way to the bucket!
🎲 Grab lucky blocks for wild items: Bazooka, Banana Peel, Tornado in a Bottle, Pie Launcher and more
⭐ Unlock crate abilities like Black Hole, Orbital Laser and Skyline Strike
💰 Earn coins every match (passing pays!) and spend them on crates, ball trails and MASSIVE basket effects
🏆 Hit level 50, then Prestige (P1–P10) to show off your icon!

🎮 PC CONTROLS
WASD Move | Space Jump | Shift Sprint
Left Click: Shoot (release in the green!) / Hold to Punch
Right Click: Pass / Call for the ball
E Steal | Jump + E Block | Q Juke | F Lob | C Tackle
1 / 2 Items | 3 Ability (pick it, then click to use)
B Shop | I Inventory | K Locker | P Settings | M Mute | H Controls
📱🎮 Full mobile and controller support!
